d:
Passive. When Voracia deals damage to at least [[3]] enemies or all surviving enemies with a skill, her appetite awakens, immediately granting Fervor to that skill.
Active. Voracia remains [[unaffected|unaffected]]. She summons a plate covering a 1-tile radius on a target tile. She uses her threads to pull enemies within 2 tiles onto the plate, knocking them down for [[4]]s. Voracia then samples the "food" on the plate, dealing [[800%]]{atk} damage to each enemy and healing herself for [[45%]] of the actual damage dealt. If enhanced by Fervor, this skill gains [[70]] Penetration when dealing damage.
In Auto Battle, this skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies.
Increases the damage dealt to [[850%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage dealt to [[900%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage dealt to [[950%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage dealt to [[1000%]]{atk}.

Voracia slashes through the area with the most enemies using her dining knife, dealing [[450%]]{atk} damage to each enemy within 7 tiles. If enhanced by Fervor, she performs an extra slash that deals [[220%]]{atk} damage.
Increases basic slash damage to [[460%]]{atk} and the extra slash's damage to [[230%]]{atk}.
Increases basic slash damage to [[470%]]{atk} and the extra slash's damage to [[240%]]{atk}.
Increases basic slash damage to [[480%]]{atk} and the extra slash's damage to [[250%]]{atk}.

Voracia splashes red wine over a 1-tile area, prioritizing the area with the most enemies. She then roasts enemies in the area with magic for [[5]]s, dealing [[45%]]{atk} damage every 0.5s. If enhanced by Fervor, the wine ignites at the end of the roast, bursting into flames and dealing an extra [[240%]]{atk} damage to enemies within range.
Increases roast damage to [[50%]]{atk} and the extra flame damage to [[260%]]{atk}.
Increases roast damage to [[55%]]{atk} and the extra flame damage to [[280%]]{atk}.
Increases roast damage to [[60%]]{atk} and the extra flame damage to [[300%]]{atk}.
Voracia increases her ATK by [[9%]] during battle. Once her appetite awakens, she increases her ATK further by [[6%]].
Voracia increases her ATK by [[12%]] during battle. Once her appetite awakens, she increases her ATK further by [[8%]].
Voracia increases her ATK by [[15%]] during battle. Once her appetite awakens, she increases her ATK further by [[10%]].

Once all her skills have gained Fervor, Voracia opens her jaws and devours the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, dealing [[900%]]{atk} damage and gaining [[35%]] of that enemy's [[basic stats|basic-stats]]. For each devour, the value gained per stat cannot exceed [[50%]] of her corresponding initial stat value. If the target is not a boss, they also permanently lose all Energy.
Increases the [[basic stats|basic-stats]] absorbed per devour to [[37.5%]], and raises the cap for each absorbed stat to [[55%]] of the initial value of Voracia's corresponding stat.
When casting this skill, Voracia devours an additional enemy with the next highest cumulative damage dealt.
Increases the [[basic stats|basic-stats]] absorbed per devour to [[40%]], and raises the cap for each absorbed stat to [[60%]] of the initial value of Voracia's corresponding stat.

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, casting an Ultimate increases damage dealt by [[8%]] for the next [[8]]s. Unstackable. The first Ultimate cast also permanently increases Energy recovery from attacking by [[8%]].
Refine 4: In Rivalry Mode, increases 10 Haste, 10 DEF Penetration.

d: When The Main Course deals damage, it also inflicts [[max HP reduction|max-hp-reduction]] equal to [[35%]] of the damage dealt.
